# Pixel Memory Match

An offline, browser-based memory-match game. Flip cards two at a time to find all 8 matching color pairs. Tracks moves, keeps matched pairs revealed, and shows a win message with a New Game button.

## How to run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step, server, network requests, or external assets required.

## Files

- `index.html` — page structure and game container
- `styles.css` — responsive layout, palette, card and button states
- `script.js` — deck shuffling, flip/match logic, move counter, win detection, reset

## Features

- 8 pairs (16 cards) with Fisher–Yates shuffle
- Move counter and win message
- Keyboard-accessible card buttons and New Game control with visible focus/hover/pressed states
- Responsive grid from 360px wide

## Accessibility

Cards are native `<button>` elements with ARIA labels, the board uses `role="grid"`, and the status area uses `aria-live="polite"`.
